rule_set.name: IACS UR S10, Rudders, sole pieces and rudder horns (Rev.8, 2025), applied to a stabilizer fin

material.name: Shipbuilding steel AH36 (higher strength)
material.source: IACS UR W11, higher strength hull structural steel, grade AH36

steps.label: Effective aspect ratio
steps.formula: A_e = 2 b / c (hull as a mirror)

steps.label: Lift slope
steps.note: Whicker and Fehlner (1958), low-aspect-ratio control surfaces, no sweep.

steps.label: Lift coefficient at the largest angle
steps.note: The second term is cross-flow lift, which matters at low aspect ratio.

steps.label: Lift, NEMO's foil model
steps.formula: L = ½ ρ V^2 A C_L

steps.label: Rudder force, IACS UR S10
steps.note: K_2 = 1.10 for NACA sections, K_3 = 0.8 outside the propeller jet.

steps.label: Twisting moment on the stock
steps.formula: Q = F c |0.33 − x_s/c|, at least 0.1 F c

steps.label: Astern speed
steps.note: UR S10.2.1.1: the astern speed is not to be taken less than half the ahead speed.

steps.label: Rudder force astern, IACS UR S10
steps.note: K_2 = 0.80 for NACA sections astern (UR S10 Table 1).

steps.label: Twisting moment astern
steps.note: Going astern the centre of pressure moves aft, to 0.66 of the chord (UR S10.2.1.2).

steps.label: Bending at the outer bearing astern
